Amy wrote about the day in the diary. Last Sunday, Amy and Owen went to the moon-lit yard. Both of them like soup and juice. Two cups of tea, please.
They took many photos at the family dinner table. Amy and Owen had great fun there. Amy's favorite animal is the bird. No one knew the answer.
Amy hopes to visit Toronto one day. The weather was rainy that day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the moon-lit yard by bike. The bakery is famous for flaky pastry.
Amy drinks juice after doing sports. Owen is interested in dancing. Amy wants to be a driver in the future.
